note: Along the South Fork Merced River near historic Wawona at the park's south end, 27 miles from Yosemite Valley; paved roads and spurs, food lockers. Most sites are short: about a third take an RV of 24 ft or more, so check the site's own length. Loop C's south row (sites 050-077) lines the river behind a strip of trees. --Claude
summary: Wawona: all year (Loop A first-come in winter at $28; $36 reserved Apr 15 - Nov 28, B/C close Oct 26), 95 sites (stored 93), RV 35 ft but only 33 of 97 catalog sites take 24 ft+, rec.gov 5 months on the 15th, 7-night max May-mid Sep. Riverfront -> creekside recommended (river ~12-20 m wetted). PIN 2.4 km off -> 37.5488,-119.6806.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'riverfront' (not --AWH) -> recommend 'creekside'. The South Fork Merced at the campground is a ~30 m boulder bed with a ~12-20 m wetted channel (Esri, Loop C frame) - under the ~30 m riverfront line. Best sites: Loop C's south row (050, 051, 052, 053, 055, 061, 062, 063, 065, 071, 072, 074, 075, 077; row ~37.5501,-119.6826 to 37.5501,-119.6848), 25-35 m from the water behind a ~15-25 m tree strip; 3DEP: site 074 at 1180 m, water ~1176 m (about 4 m over ~30 m, an easy walk down). Of those, 053, 072, 074, 075 (35 ft) and 063, 065 (27 ft) take a 23-ft rig; all are sold by the night. Loop A (022-030) is ~40-55 m back behind a tree belt; Loop B 30-60 m under scattered canopy. Creekside rests on the C-loop row; nothing is open-ground riverfront.

PIN: stored 37.54150,-119.65480 is ~2.4 km east-south-east of the campground (near Wawona village / the horse camp area); move to the catalog site centroid 37.54877,-119.68058 (Loop A ~37.5450,-119.6735, Loop C ~37.5505,-119.6838). Elevation at the pin may change (3DEP at the C row ~1180 m, A loop ~1190 m; stored 1246).
